command.name: security key-manager onboard verify-backup
command.description: This command verifies the backup data and the passphrase of the Onboard Key Manager for the admin Vserver.

parameter.name: cmd-result
parameter.description: The result of the verification command.

example.p: The following example displays the verification of the onboard key management backup data for the admin Vserver:
